node.title: KoalaBear m10 Scott-strip lower-degree router
node.closure: kernel-free flag exclusion plus Scott-strip synchronized-column routing
node.statement: For an inner-degree-10 terminal, a trivial block-kernel projection forces the exact A6 or S6 action on sixty point/two-subset flags, neither of which has subdegree four. Otherwise the derived block kernel is subdirect in six copies of A5, A6, or A10. Scott strips have common support size 1,2,3,6; size one contradicts the actual transverse quartic suborbit, while sizes 2,3,6 preserve synchronized column blocks and force a second geometric decomposition of that inner degree. Thus every m10 producer routes strictly to m=2,3,6, leaving 18 independent transverse types in degrees 2,3,4,6. This is routing, not nonexistence of every degree-10 decomposition, and no owner, charge, u2, cap 68, or row close is claimed.
